title: SNIP follow-on Case Series Using v3 Device
summary: Case series of infants with anterior ankyloglossia being treated by the Sublingual Neonatal Incision Platform device

interventions.name: Frenectomy of anterior ankylogossia using the novel device

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Ankyloglossia requiring intervention

Exclusion Criteria:

* Concomitant morphological variation in the oral cavity which could compromise frenotomy
* Blood dyscrasia
* Immunocompromise
